products.name: Kore.ai
products.note: Enterprise agentic AI platform; multi-agent orchestration; comprehensive governance dashboard with audit logs, RBAC, and guardrails; 400+ Fortune 2000 customers

profile_text.body:
Kore.ai is an enterprise AI company that describes itself as a leader in agentic AI, focused on helping businesses improve customer service and employee productivity. Its platform is designed to let organizations build, deploy, and orchestrate AI agents across customer-facing and internal workflows, with an emphasis on production readiness rather than experimentation. The company positions its offering around features such as multi-agent orchestration with parallel execution and independent fault recovery, agentic RAG search, runtime-layer compliance controls, pre-deployment workflow validation, and complete interaction logging for audit purposes.

The company's primary product is the Kore.ai Agent Platform 2.0, which it describes as a unified infrastructure for both scripted and reasoning AI, intended to replace separate vendor contracts for those two capabilities. The platform includes a governance dashboard with audit logs, role-based access controls, and guardrails, and is built to avoid vendor lock-in by keeping agent definitions portable across underlying large language models. Kore.ai reports having more than 400 Fortune 2000 customers and cites recognition from Forrester as a leader in its Cognitive Search Platforms 2025 Wave report, where the company received the highest score possible across 11 criteria and ranked highest in the strategy category. The company also appears in Forrester Wave assessments for Conversational AI for both customer service and employee services, as well as the Everest Group Agentic AI Products PEAK Matrix.

The held facts on file for Kore.ai confirm its categorization as an enterprise AI platform with multi-agent orchestration capabilities, consistent with what the company's own site describes. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
